title: Betti numbers of ideals generated by $n+1$ powers of general linear forms
summary: We study ideals generated by $n+1$ powers of general linear forms in $R= k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$. By generalizing the ideas in a recent paper of Diethorn et al., we determine the Betti numbers of such ideals when at least one generator is a square. It follows that all such ideals are level. As a consequence, we show that a generic ideal in $R$ generated by $n+1$ forms, with at least one quadric generator, is level.
